context.authoritativeRule: Document stores MIDI velocity 1–127; detent edit paths write level representatives via velocityForLevel / canonicalNoteVelocity; level geometry parks every note of a level on the same Y.
context.scenario: Note stored 95; audible detents include representatives 50 and 100 (same audible class as 95 until edit snaps).

models.name: Continuous rail
models.summary: Always plot dots on 1–127 Y; draw faint level guides. Drag free, release snaps to nearest level rep.
models.snapUnderstanding: Guides + release jump teach snap; status shows post-snap velocity.
models.restore95: Only Undo, or type 95 if dialog stores exact (today it canonical-snaps).
models.fit: Fights current categorical axis and mixed-selection level drags; busy at many notes.

models.name: Level rail only
models.summary: Keep today’s level Y for all notes. Off-rep is invisible until status/dialog. First drag/commit snaps to rep.
models.snapUnderstanding: Audition changes only at level crossings; labels Volume N (rep).
models.restore95: Undo after commit; no on-canvas held cue.
models.fit: Compact, matches code, fails the 95 discoverability case.

models.name: Held mark + origin restore
models.summary: Keep level Y. Mark held notes. Live gesture remembers origin and restores exact stored velocity when the pointer returns to the origin level band. No new modes or prefs.
models.snapUnderstanding: Leaving origin level writes/previews that level’s rep; ruler stays Volume N (rep).
models.restore95: Same gesture: return to origin band → 95. After commit: Undo. Explicit: Set velocity… types exact 95 (no snap on typed entry).
models.fit: Uses m_origVelocities + level geometry; compact; solves held + restore.

models.name: Alt fine / level coarse
models.summary: Default level snap; Alt-drag edits continuous stored velocity without snap.
models.snapUnderstanding: Two gestures; easy to miss Alt; conflicts with existing modifier load (Ctrl select, velocity-drag chord).
models.fit: Powerful but heavier vocabulary and chord collision risk.

recommendation.name: Held mark + origin restore
rationale: Preserves detented VelocityAxis and Volume N (rep) labels already painted.
Makes off-detent 95 visible without a second axis or modal.
Restore of exact 95 is local to the edit gesture (origin), then Undo—no config.
Aligns roll, lane, and status on one controlled vocabulary.

lane.dotY: level Y for 95’s audible class (same row as Volume that owns 95)
lane.heldMark: selected held note: hollow ring or 1px gap ring around filled dot; unselected held: same at lower contrast
lane.rollBar: bar height tracks stored 95; optional 1px held notch when selected

firstEdit.press: Cache origin per note (already m_origVelocities). No write yet.
firstEdit.crossLevelOrDragThreshold: Preview snaps to level rep under pointer (velocityForLevel). Cursor blank as today.
firstEdit.audition: Retrigger only when level changes (existing roll pattern).

movingBetweenDetents.mouse: Vertical drag steps level-by-level; horizontal freehand sweep paints level under Y.
movingBetweenDetents.clickRulerLabel: Selection → that level’s rep (existing graduation click; label affordance).
movingBetweenDetents.keyboard: No new chords. Existing Undo/redo. Optional later: same nudge keys as roll if already bound to velocity—out of scope unless present.

sameGesture.action: Move pointer back into the origin level’s hit band (level that contained origin 95).
sameGesture.result: Preview/commit target = origin 95 (exact), not Volume rep.

afterCommit.explicit: Set velocity… → enter 95 → store exact 95 (change from today’s canonical snap on dialog OK)
afterCommit.notOffered: No sticky Restore button, no prefs, no second modal

restoring95.rollParity: Ctrl/vel-bar drag uses same origin-band exact restore while gesture alive; release outside origin keeps last snapped rep.

mixedSelections.compatibleDetents: Shared level axis; each note levelDelta from its own origin level; held marks per-note; origin restore per-note when pointer level == that note’s origin level.
mixedSelections.incompatibleDetents: Axis falls back continuous (existing velocityAxisDetents null). No Volume labels. Drag uses canonicalNoteVelocity per note. Status: velocity <n> only. Held mark omitted (no shared level model).
mixedSelections.mixedHeldAndOnDetent: Independent marks; snap still by level; origin restore only notes whose origin level matches pointer level.
mixedSelections.clickVolumeLabel: All selected writable notes → that label’s rep (exact write of rep value).

accessibility.focusDot: Name: Velocity 95, Volume 3, held. Help: Drag to change volume level. Return to origin level to keep 95.
accessibility.focusRuler: Name: Volume 3, snap 100. Help: Click to set selection to 100.
accessibility.liveRegionOnDrag: Volume 3, 100 then on origin return 95, held, origin
accessibility.contrast: Held ring uses selection edge / secondary text tokens already in lane; active level labels stay bold + item_selected_background ticks.

mouseKeyboard.laneDotDrag: Relative level drag; blank cursor; Esc cancel; release commits.
mouseKeyboard.laneEmptyDrag: Freehand sweep to level under Y (rep write).
mouseKeyboard.rollVelBarOrModifierDrag: Same snap + origin restore rules as lane.
mouseKeyboard.rightClickMenu: Set velocity… shows stored value; OK stores typed value exact (no auto-snap).

failureModes.risk: User never sees 95≠rep and thinks lane lost data.
failureModes.mitigation: Held ring + status/tooltip always include held when selected/hovered.

failureModes.risk: User overshoots origin band and cannot re-find 95 mid-gesture.
failureModes.mitigation: Origin band = full level row hit, not sub-pixel Y; status shows origin when armed; Esc cancels to 95.

failureModes.risk: Today’s dialog canonical-snaps 95→rep and blocks explicit restore.
failureModes.mitigation: Typed Set velocity… stores exact; snap only from level UI (drag/label/sweep).

failureModes.risk: Incompatible multi-note selection drops Volume labels; held language disappears.
failureModes.mitigation: Status stays velocity-only; no false Volume N; avoid inventing a merged scale.

failureModes.risk: User confuses label rep 100 with held 95 on same row.
failureModes.mitigation: Dot stays on shared level Y; held mark + numeric 95 in status/tooltip; never relabel Volume to 95.

failureModes.risk: Continuous roll bar suggests 95 sounds different from 100.
failureModes.mitigation: Announce Volume N with velocity; audition only on level change.

rejectedForPrimary.why: Breaks categorical PSG lane already shipped; weak mixed level edit.
No held affordance; restore is Undo-only folklore.
Extra modifier mode; collides with Ctrl select / velocity-drag chord; more verbose.
